title: Guided Bike Tour on Historical Kettle Valley Railway at Myra Canyon & Wine Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
This Guided Bicycle Tour includes bike rental, the use of a helmet, a bottle of water, and the service of a guide. Pick-up and drop-off transportation from your accommodation in Kelowna or West Kelowna is included as well as transportation throughout the day to and from Myra Canyon and transportation to the wineries. You will start your tour at Myra Canyon at 9 am, so we will pick you up before this start time. (Exact time to be confirmed.) The tasting fees at the wineries are included, but lunch is not. We have option for a Gazelle pedal assist E-Bike

A minimum group size of 4 people is required for this booking.
